name: datacanvas
description: Transform CSVs, spreadsheets, and business tables into interactive real-time visual dashboards inside ChatGPT sidebar & conversation panels. Filter data, inspect KPIs, and download executive PDF reports.

interface.longDescription: DataCanvas transforms spreadsheets, CSVs, and sales tables into interactive dashboards in ChatGPT conversation panels. Filter data, toggle dynamic charts (bars, lines, donut), inspect KPIs in real-time, and download executive PDF reports with zero manual rework.
